title: Tsunamis, Airport, Hotel, School, Theatre, mansions, and steep road
content: I am floored by this. I’m pretty woo and this has taken me aback. I haven’t been to the mall or bathrooms in MW, but i absolutely know the steep road and have driven it at least twice. It’s terrifying. I know this all happens in the same place bc it all feels the same. I’ve seen two tsunamis- one at the airport where I was up in the tower or somewhere up high that the tsunami reached. It hit the glass walls/windows and I was scared but knew it wasn’t going to hurt me as I watched others get washed away. The other time I saw a tsunami, I was in the hotel penthouse. Again, huge wall/windows, but this time the tsunami was much farther away. I’ve also been to the school/theatre a couple of times. The school sounds a little different and is connected to the theatre, but I don’t think I’ve ever been in a classroom. I just walk down these hallways where I can see classes are going on. Maybe I did go in one once, but I felt like I wasn’t supposed to be there so left. Walking the hallways is circling the theatre/auditorium. I can see something is going on there but I’m usually on the outside watching from the school halls. I think I saw some of it once and it was kind of like a school play but I was all the way in the back and it was blurry. The school halls lead to the mansions? Or at least a more residential area of this place. And I’ve been through parts of this house, know there’s more that I’m not allowed to go into, and some of the parts of the house feel like I should’ve have been in anyway. It feels old and damp, like a beach house but with antique furniture. There’s a lot of red crushed velvet in the school/theatre and the rooms in the mansion have more of a green tone. The last time I went, I saw the theme park/water park. It was kind of like a low rent Disney/waterpark hybrid and I knew how to get around in tunnels there. Is any of this familiar? I don’t think I was in gate but I do remember the pink stuff for some reason and the tangrams and weird shapes. And headphones 🫣
